info.title: Capacities API
info.description:
Interactive **reference** for all routes of the Capacities API.

You can add your `cap-api-…` token in the **`Bearer Token`** field to make requests in this dashboard.

tags.name: Object
tags.description: Operations on objects in a space

tags.name: Objects
tags.description: Search and list objects in a space

get.description:
Returns information about the space associated with the API token.
**Rate limit**: 10 requests per 60 seconds

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK

icon.description: Icon of the space, if set.

get.description:
Returns structures visible in the space, including property definitions and collections. See [Structures](/api/concepts/structures) and [Properties](/api/concepts/properties).
**Rate limit**: 10 requests per 60 seconds

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK

id.description: Structure id (UUID for custom types, or a built-in id such as RootPage).

title.description: Singular display name of the structure.

pluralName.description: Plural display name of the structure.

id.description: Stable property definition id (UUID or built-in key such as `title`).

writable.description: Whether the property can be set on create or update.

multiple.description: When `type` is `label`: `true` if multiple options may be selected, `false` for single-select.

labelSet.description: Fixed selectable options when `type` is `label`. Omitted for other property types.

allowedStructures.description: When `type` is `entity`: structure ids of objects that may be linked in this property.

labelColor.description: Hex color used as the label color for this structure.

collections.description: Non-default collections (databases) that use this structure.

get.description:
Returns one object by id, including typed properties and optional block content. See [Objects](/api/concepts/objects) and [Properties](/api/concepts/properties).
**Rate limit**: 30 requests per 60 seconds

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK

structureId.description: Structure id (UUID for custom types, or a built-in id such as RootPage).

collections.description: Collection ids this object is currently assigned to.

blocks.description: Block content keyed by property definition id.

files.description: File resources attached to this object. Present only for media object types.

url.description: Signed URL for downloading the original file.

expirationDate.description: ISO 8601 datetime after which the signed URL expires. Re-fetch the object to get a fresh URL.

patch.description:
Updates an object by id. Provide at least one of `properties`, `collections`, or `blocks`. See [Objects](/api/concepts/objects).
**Rate limit**: 30 requests per 60 seconds

collections.description: Collection ids to assign. Pass an empty array to use the default collection for this structure.

properties.description: Map of property definition id → value; only include keys you want to change.

blocks.description: Block content keyed by property definition id.

deleteRequested.description: When `true`, moves the object to trash. When `false`, restores a trashed object.

delete.description:
Deletes an object (moves to trash by default). Pass `hardDelete=true` to permanently delete. See [Objects](/api/concepts/objects).
**Rate limit**: 30 requests per 60 seconds

parameters.description: Unique identifier of the object to delete.

parameters.name: hardDelete

schema.description: When `true`, permanently deletes the object. When omitted or `false`, moves the object to trash.

parameters.description: When `true`, permanently deletes the object. When omitted or `false`, moves the object to trash.

post.description:
Creates a weblink or media object from a URL. Optional `properties` set title and description; optional `markdown` or `blocks` add notes (not both). See [Markdown](/api/concepts/markdown) and [Blocks](/api/concepts/blocks).
**Rate limit**: 10 requests per 60 seconds

url.description: URL to save as a web resource object.

markdown.description: Optional Markdown content to add to the notes of the new object.

blocks.description: Optional block content keyed by property definition id (e.g. `media_notes`).

properties.description: Optional title and description overrides for the created web resource.

post.description:
Searches objects in the current space by matching the query against object titles. Results are ordered by relevance and can be limited to specific structures with `structureIds`.
**Rate limit**: 30 requests per 60 seconds

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK

query.description: Text to match against object titles.

structureIds.description: Optional structure id filters. When set, only objects of these types are returned.

items.description: Structure id (UUID for custom types, or a built-in id such as RootPage).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 20, maximum 50.

id.description: Unique identifier of the matching object.

structureId.description: Structure id (UUID for custom types, or a built-in id such as RootPage).

title.description: Display title of the matching object.

results.description: Matching objects ordered by search relevance.

post.description:
Appends content to an object as blocks or Markdown (provide exactly one of `blocks` or `markdown`). See [Blocks](/api/concepts/blocks) for position, parent, and property options.
**Rate limit**: 30 requests per 60 seconds

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK

propertyId.description: Property definition id for the block field.

parentBlockId.description: Parent block id when nesting under `end` or `start`.

blocks.description: Blocks to append. Omit `id` on new blocks.

markdown.description: Markdown to convert and append as blocks.

structureId.description: Structure id (UUID for custom types, or a built-in id such as RootPage).

collections.description: Collection ids this object is currently assigned to.

blocks.description: Block content keyed by property definition id.

files.description: File resources attached to this object. Present only for media object types.

url.description: Signed URL for downloading the original file.

expirationDate.description: ISO 8601 datetime after which the signed URL expires. Re-fetch the object to get a fresh URL.

post.description:
Appends content to a daily note as blocks or Markdown (provide exactly one of `blocks` or `markdown`; processed asynchronously). See [Blocks](/api/concepts/blocks#daily-notes).
**Rate limit**: 30 requests per 60 seconds

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK

date.description: Daily note day (ISO 8601, UTC midnight). Defaults to today.

noTimeStamp.description: When `true`, omit the timestamp heading block.

blocks.description: Blocks to append. Omit `id` on new blocks.

markdown.description: Markdown content to append to the daily note.
